description: Land Acquisition - Gonnoruwa  & Keliyapura D/S Division, Hambanthota D/S Division, Hambanthota District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land lots being acquired for public purpose (road development), including land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
